name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back braced across a flat bench, feet planted hip-width apart, and a barbell centered over your hip creases.
Hold the bar steady with both hands, tuck your chin slightly, and brace your core tightly.
Drive through your heels to raise your hips until your torso and thighs form a horizontal line with shins vertical.
Squeeze your glutes firmly at the top, then hinge at your hips to lower your pelvis smoothly back down.
tips: Keep your ribs tucked down so you extend cleanly through your glutes without arching your lower back.
Use a folded towel beneath the bar if it presses uncomfortably into your hips.
